requirement_text: replacement of damaged pipelines by Hubless
standard_title: Cast Iron Hubless Pipes and Fittings for Waste Water and Ventilation Systems - Specification
applicability_reason: The tender explicitly specifies Hubless pipeline replacement for toilet drainage. IS 15905 is the sole national Indian Standard specifying dimensions, coatings, and elastomeric mechanical coupling joints for hubless cast iron soil/waste pipes.
evidence: Clause 1 Scope of IS 15905:2011 specifies requirements for hubless (spigotless) cast iron pipes and fittings intended for gravity wastewater and ventilation piping in buildings.
evidence_source: BIS Catalogue / CED 53 (Pipes & Fittings); CPWD Civil Specifications 2019 Vol 2 Chapter 17 (Clause 17.2).
alternative_standards: IS 1239 (Part 1) : 2004 (Steel tubes/GI water supply pipes in same toilet block); IS 1729 : 2002 (Socketed CI pipes - rejected because hubless design is explicitly specified).
verification_needed: None for standard applicability. Mechanical coupling manufacturer brand (stainless steel shield coupling) may be verified from BOQ.

requirement_text: wall tiles

applicability_reason: Tender requires replacement of toilet wall tiles. IS 15622 is the umbrella Indian Standard governing technical properties for all pressed ceramic glazed wall tiles and vitrified tiles.
evidence: Clause 1 Scope of IS 15622:2017 covers ceramic tiles for floor and wall finishes (water absorption groups B Ia, B Ib, B IIa, B IIb, B III); Ceramic Tiles (Quality Control) Order 2020 mandates ISI Mark.
evidence_source: BIS Catalogue / CED 5 (Flooring & Wall Finishing); DPIIT QCO Notification S.O. 4467(E).
alternative_standards: IS 1443 : 1972 (Code of practice for laying/finishing flooring and wall tiles); IS 13753 / IS 13755 (Withdrawn/superseded).
verification_needed: None. Mandatory ISI Mark under Central QCO.
